coordinate_system.orientation_notes: X follows the sleeve and bore axis. Y is vertical in the axial front and detail views; Z is normal to the front projection plane, into the page. The left view looks along +X. No datum-based coordinate origin is defined.

features.name: External tapered section
features.description: External conical taper transitioning from the main body diameter down to the end cylindrical land.

features.name: End cylindrical land
features.description: Outer cylindrical land at the axial end of the component with a reference wall thickness to the internal bore.

features.name: ID entry chamfer
features.description: Internal diameter chamfer at the end face, called out for both ends of the component.

features.name: Outer cylinder body
features.description: Main outer cylindrical surface and body of the sleeve, defining the overall length of the component.

geometry.position_description: Centred on horizontal cylinder axis along X

features.name: Internal through bore
features.description: Precision cylindrical through bore running along the horizontal axis through the entire length of the part.

geometry.position_description: Coaxial with part body along X axis

relationships.detail: The through bore is explicitly described as coaxial with the cylindrical body along X.
The external taper transitions from the main body and follows the component's rotational axis.
The end cylindrical land and adjoining external taper share the component's rotational axis.
The ID entry chamfers are located at the two ends of the central through bore.

datum_scheme.datum_hierarchy_notes: No datum definitions or GD&T datum references are provided.

Coating: PHOSPHATE COAT PER PS-119.0. General notes: TOLERANCE: TOL (UOS): ±0.5. DEBURR: BREAK ALL SHARP EDGES 0.5 MAX.. FINISH: PHOSPHATE COAT PER PS-119.0. Extraction notes: Leading digits in the revision table date column are slightly truncated by the border.

assumptions.text: The DETAIL Z label on front_view:F1 is interpreted as locating an end-region enlargement, not establishing identity between the entire main cylindrical body and detail_z:F1. The body and taper remain separate features because their descriptions and axial spans identify distinct surfaces.
detail_z:F2 remains separate from front_view:F1: it represents the short end cylindrical land, whereas front_view:F1 represents the main body and carries the overall part length.
detail_z:F3 is retained as one interchangeable two-instance chamfer feature. BOTH ENDS establishes its multiplicity; no separately identified chamfer observations require aggregate grouping.

The left view is used only for axisymmetric spatial context. It supplies no feature observations or dimensions to merge, so the main-body diameter scope remains a clarification rather than an inferred geometry value.
The large-end outside-diameter limits specified in Detail Z apply continuously to the main straight cylindrical body.
